verdict.rationale: Asana's App Directory lists integrations that offer real-time two-way sync between Asana tasks and GitLab issues, plus one-way or two-way sync with GitHub, GitLab, Jira, and Azure DevOps, and Bitbucket sync of issues, comments, assignees, and custom fields. These appear to be marketplace connectors rather than a native first-party feature; the GitHub integration explicitly described only pushes PR status one-way into tasks. Webhooks and the REST API allow building a custom sync. Missing for 10: evidence of a native first-party bi-directional repo-issue sync, documentation of field mapping and conflict handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the two-way sync works.
